title: snap-system-arm64 → ubuntu/master
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index c6f72ee..f22c6b2 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+livecd-rootfs (27.04.1) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium
+
+  * Enable enhanced secureboot on ARM64. This will include the snap system
+  in the image, which relies on a snap kernel model and gadget to be available
+
+ -- Antoine Lassagne <antoine.lassagne@canonical.com>  Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:31:09 +0100
+
 livecd-rootfs (26.10.19) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   [ Valentin Haudiquet ]
diff --git a/live-build/auto/config b/live-build/auto/config
index f7d0bb2..3d7448e 100755
--- a/live-build/auto/config
+++ b/live-build/auto/config
@@ -884,8 +884,9 @@ case $PROJECT in
 
 				# Enchanced secureboot stuff
 				case "$ARCH" in
-				    amd64)
+				    amd64|arm64)
 					# the enhanced-secureboot layer, contains all packages for the enhanced secureboot install
+					# this will trigger the 030-ubuntu-live-system-seed.binary hook
 					add_package minimal.enhanced-secureboot cryptsetup boot-managed-by-snapd
 					add_package minimal.standard.enhanced-secureboot cryptsetup boot-managed-by-snapd
 					derive_language_layers minimal.enhanced-secureboot desktop-minimal desktop-default-languages "$seeded_langs"
diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu/hooks/030-ubuntu-live-system-seed.binary b/live-build/ubuntu/hooks/030-ubuntu-live-system-seed.binary
index 00ac57b..2576448 100644
--- a/live-build/ubuntu/hooks/030-ubuntu-live-system-seed.binary
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu/hooks/030-ubuntu-live-system-seed.binary
@@ -150,8 +150,8 @@ echo 'Checked out canonical-models revision' "$(git -C "${canonical_models_tree}
 
 model_version=$(release_ver | sed 's/\.//')
 
-dangerous_model="${canonical_models_tree}"/ubuntu-classic-"${model_version}"-amd64-dangerous.model
-stable_model="${canonical_models_tree}"/ubuntu-classic-"${model_version}"-amd64.model
+dangerous_model="${canonical_models_tree}"/ubuntu-classic-"${model_version}"-"${ARCH}"-dangerous.model
+stable_model="${canonical_models_tree}"/ubuntu-classic-"${model_version}"-"${ARCH}".model
 
 prepare_args=()
